import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Set style
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid')
sns.set_palette("husl")

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(20, 16))

# 1. Top 10 dog breeds by count
ax1 = plt.subplot(2, 2, 1)
breed_counts = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(10)
bars = ax1.barh(range(len(breed_counts)), breed_counts.values)
ax1.set_yticks(range(len(breed_counts)))
ax1.set_yticklabels(breed_counts.index, fontsize=10)
ax1.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Top 10 Dog Breeds in Zurich', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=15)
ax1.invert_yaxis()
for i, (bar, count) in enumerate(zip(bars, breed_counts.values)):
    ax1.text(bar.get_width() + bar.get_width()*0.01, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2, 
             f'{count:,}', va='center', fontsize=9)

# 2. Dog distribution by district
ax2 = plt.subplot(2, 2, 2)
district_counts = df['KreisLang'].value_counts().sort_index()
colors = plt.cm.Set3(np.linspace(0, 1, len(district_counts)))
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax2.pie(district_counts.values, labels=district_counts.index, 
                                   colors=colors, autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90,
                                   textprops={'fontsize': 9})
ax2.set_title('Dog Distribution by District', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=15)

# 3. Dog age distribution
ax3 = plt.subplot(2, 2, 3)
age_order = df['AlterVHundLang'].dropna().unique()
age_order = sorted(age_order, key=lambda x: int(x.split('-')[0]) if '-' in x else 0)
age_counts = df['AlterVHundLang'].value_counts().reindex(age_order)
bars = ax3.bar(range(len(age_counts)), age_counts.values, color='skyblue', edgecolor='navy')
ax3.set_xticks(range(len(age_counts)))
ax3.set_xticklabels(age_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=9)
ax3.set_xlabel('Dog Age Group', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Distribution of Dogs by Age Group', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=15)
for i, (bar, count) in enumerate(zip(bars, age_counts.values)):
    ax3.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2, bar.get_height() + bar.get_height()*0.01, 
             f'{count:,}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=8, rotation=0)

# 4. Dog gender distribution over years
ax4 = plt.subplot(2, 2, 4)
gender_by_year = df.groupby(['StichtagDatJahr', 'SexHundLang']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
gender_by_year.plot(kind='line', marker='o', ax=ax4, linewidth=2.5)
ax4.set_xlabel('Year', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Dog Gender Distribution Over Years', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=15)
ax4.legend(title='Gender', title_fontsize=11, fontsize=10)
ax4.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Adjust layout and save
plt.suptitle('Zurich Dog Registration Analysis', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150, facecolor='white')
plt.close()
